report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Sanjay Chopra | Age: 32
Body Temperature at Scene: 27.8°C | Ambient Temperature: 31.7°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 11.8 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]
  2. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]
  3. Dorsal: Pattern bruising consistent with impact [MODERATE]
  4. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]
  5. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): GHB

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed pattern suggesting body repositioned post-mortem.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a spontaneous violent altercation. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
